# Jem

[Queen’s Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy)

## Appearance

Jem has curly red hair inherited from his mother. He also features frank hazel eyes, which resemble those of his father.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER III. THE INGLESIDE CHILDREN P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)_

## Personality

A sturdy and reliable individual, he is known as the most fair-minded boy in [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary. He possesses an inquisitive nature, preferring to investigate the truth of any statement for himself rather than taking things on faith, and demonstrates a thoughtful character by regularly bringing his mother bouquets of Mayflowers. Driven by a desire to see a great battle and become a triumphant general, he deeply loves [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) above any other place on earth. Additionally, he is a skilled fighter capable of quickly defeating an opponent, and he works diligently toward studying for the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) entrance examination.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P1](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER III. THE INGLESIDE CHILDREN P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011), [v5 CHAPTER IV. ## History

Jem Blythe once stuck out his tongue at Mrs. [Alec Davis](../character/alec-davis.md), causing her to refuse to employ his father again. The previous summer, he suffered a foot injury that caused his family great distress, and he was also bequeathed a museum of curios by Captain Jim [Boyd](../character/uncle-jim.md). After moving to a new home in the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) with his family, Jem cooked caught trout during an evening picnic in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) with his siblings, where they soon met and befriended the Meredith children. Later, when the Meredith children faced local scandal, Jem joined them in the graveyard and suggested they form a [Good-Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#good-conduct-club) so they could discipline themselves. On his final evening before leaving home to attend Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), Jem gathered with the other children in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), speaking with Walter about battles and following the Pied Piper's call into the future.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P17](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P21](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0021), [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P56](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0056), [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P65](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0065), [v5 CHAPTER III. THE INGLESIDE CHILDREN P4](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0004), [v5 CHAPTER III. THE INGLESIDE CHILDREN P7](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0007), +17 more_

## Quotes

> "Not exactly. You’d have to think up different ways of punishment to suit the person. You wouldn’t punish each other—you’d punish yourselves. I read all about such a club in a story-book. You try it and see how it works."
>
> — Jem — [v5 CHAPTER XXIII. THE GOOD-CONDUCT CLUB P58](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0058)

> “Oh, I wish we had the old days back again,” exclaimed Jem. “I’d love to be a soldier—a great, triumphant general. I’d give everything to see a big battle.”
>
> — Jem — [v5 CHAPTER XXXV. “LET THE PIPER COME” P11](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0011)

> “I’ve done my part frying the trout,” protested Jem, who hated saying grace. “Let Walter say it. He likes saying grace. And cut it short, too, Walt. I’m starving.”
>
> — Jem — [v5 CHAPTER III. THE INGLESIDE CHILDREN P28](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0028)

> "I’ll tell you what to do. Form a Good-Conduct Club and punish yourselves every time you do anything that’s not right."
>
> — Jem — [v5 CHAPTER XXIII. THE GOOD-CONDUCT CLUB P54](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0054)

> “Let the Piper come and welcome,” he cried, waving his hand. “I’ll follow him gladly round and round the world.”
>
> — Jem — [v5 CHAPTER XXXV. “LET THE PIPER COME” P20](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0020)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--jem.md)

[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) is Jem's mother, with whom he shared his earliest years prior to the family moving from their house of dreams to [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary. As he grew up alongside the other children in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) remained a nurturing maternal figure in his life, comforting her children when troubles arose.

### [Faith](../character/faith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/faith--jem.md)

Jem and [Faith](../character/faith.md) became sworn friends and allies after the [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) and Meredith families met over cooked trout in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley). ### [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jem--jerry-corcoran.md)
